newsitem.title: USA: California law school says may have reused needles.
newsitem.headline: California law school says may have reused needles.

text.p: A Los Angeles law school said after testing for tuberculosis among about 120 students, it discovered there was a possibility the needles used in testing might have been used more than once.

Loyola Law School said it was trying to find out if the needles were reused. Students tested for tuberculosis were asked to take a blood test to make sure there had been no transmission of diseases from the needles.
Health experts said the possibility of transmission in such circumstances was extremely low, the school said. Loyola said it had informed the Los Angeles County Health Department.
